dedupe_keys.name: vicglobal soil and vegetation model parameters

description: VICGlobal supplies soil, vegetation and elevation-band parameter inputs for version 5 of the Variable Infiltration Capacity hydrological model. The own Zenodo record lists NetCDF and classic-format parameter archives, masks and a README. A modeller can use the global inputs to build runoff, drought or reservoir-inflow simulations where local parameter files are unavailable. Gridded soil and vegetation properties remain approximations, and model setup must match the archive's VIC version and spatial domain. The files do not include observed streamflow for independent validation. Zenodo states CC BY 4.0. I read repository metadata and the Scientific Data article without downloading archives or running VIC. The related VIC model software DOI cited by the article is distinct from these parameters, and the preparation scripts are reviewed separately. No exact catalogue parameter record was found.
